Hi Elena / Tom —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our call and a proposal for the PoC path so we can converge on the right deployment mode quickly. Attachment: trial-scope-v1.pdf

High-level options we discussed (short):
- Hosted API (fastest to start, least ops overhead; limited control over data residency)
- Dedicated capacity (reserved GPU pools, predictable throughput, isolation in our managed tenancy)
- Private VPC / On‑prem (customer-managed network, KMS/HSM integrations, best for PHI/regulatory needs)

What I heard from you on the call:
- Primary constraint: PHI concerns for clinical notes ingestion — current priority is meeting audit + KMS requirements.
- Timeline: want a 3–4 week technical trial to validate latency and end-to-end data flow.
- Success criteria will include: model-quality parity with your baseline prompts, <300ms median token latency at our test load, and audit/logging evidence for data handling.

Suggested next steps (pick one):
1) If you can accept managed isolation: run a 3-week Dedicated trial (we provision reserved capacity and map endpoints).
2) If PHI/data residency requires customer VPC: run a 4-week Private VPC pilot (we provide control-plane + on‑prem/VPC connectors).

Questions for you so we can lock scope:
- Which deployment mode do you want the trial to target as the primary path?
- Who will be the customer technical owner for networking/KMS? (name + email)
- Are there any compliance docs we should review before kickoff? (SOC2 / encryption / data retention)

Proposed timeline if we start next week:
- Day 0: kickoff and access exchange (service account, KMS contacts)
- Week 1: infra setup + smoke tests
- Week 2: integration + perf baseline
- Week 3: validation, logging evidence collection, and final readout

If helpful I can also sketch a canary routing plan (Dedicated fallback to Hosted) so you can test graceful degradation.

Thanks — I’ll wait for your preference and the technical owner.

Best,

Nice summary, Jonas. A few technical notes from infra readiness perspective (attachment: infra-feasibility-notes.md).

Key points:
- Private VPC path is feasible. We support both customer-managed KMS (recommended) and integration with hosted KMS, but for HSM-backed keys we will need a short security design call to confirm protocols and key wrapping approach.
- Expect 3–5 business days of networking setup if the customer provides network CIDR and peering/VPN details up front.
